title: Totally Radical & Slightly Gross
description: A nostalgic blast through 80s movies, music icons, and Saturday morning toys — followed by 90s TV favorites — then straight to the bathroom for PG-rated potty humor you can't un-hear.

questions.question: Three scientists start a ghost-catching business in New York City and ultimately face a 100-foot-tall marshmallow man in this 1984 comedy.
Marty McFly travels back to 1955 in a plutonium-powered DeLorean in this 1985 blockbuster directed by Robert Zemeckis and produced by Steven Spielberg.
questions.answer: What is Back to the Future?

questions.question: Tom Cruise starred in this 1986 film about Navy fighter pilot training, whose iconic volleyball scene and soundtrack became equally famous.
Five students — the brain, the athlete, the basket case, the princess, and the criminal — spend a Saturday in detention in this 1985 John Hughes film.
Patrick Swayze and Jennifer Grey danced their way into movie history with this 1987 summer hit, introducing the immortal line 'Nobody puts Baby in a corner.'
This Minneapolis-born superstar released the film and album 'Purple Rain' in 1984 and later renamed himself an unpronounceable symbol.
'Girls Just Want to Have Fun' and 'Time After Time' made this wild-haired, multi-colored New Wave singer a defining icon of the 1980s.
The first rap song to top the Billboard Hot 100, this rapper's 1990 hit 'Ice Ice Baby' borrowed its bass line from Queen and David Bowie's 'Under Pressure.'
This British new wave band took its name from the villainous character in Jane Fonda's 1968 sci-fi film 'Barbarella' — and scored 80s hits with 'Hungry Like the Wolf' and 'Rio.'
Led by the flamboyant Boy George, this British pop group spent six weeks at #1 in the UK in 1983 with 'Karma Chameleon.'
This 1984 Hasbro toy line (and animated series) featured robots that could transform between vehicles and fighting machines, with Autobots and Decepticons at war.
'By the power of Grayskull!' is the battle cry of this 1983 Filmation animated hero, who transformed from the meek Prince Adam into the most powerful man in the universe.
These soft-bodied 1983 dolls came with unique adoption papers and individual names — and the holiday frenzy to buy one sparked near-riots in toy stores across America.
This 1983 Hasbro toy line featuring colorful small horses with symbols on their flanks became one of the decade's best-selling toys and has inspired multiple animated series.
This talking 1985 teddy bear could read along with pre-recorded audio cassette tapes and became the most coveted holiday gift of its year, selling out almost immediately.
John Kricfalusi's Nickelodeon show featuring a neurotic chihuahua and a dim-witted cat was beloved by adults for its edgy, gross-out humor far beyond what parents expected from a kids' cartoon.
questions.answer: What is The Ren & Stimpy Show?

questions.question: This Fox teen drama set among the wealthy youth of Southern California ran for ten seasons from 1990 to 2000, making stars of Luke Perry and Shannen Doherty.
Zack Morris, A.C. Slater, and Screech Powers navigated high school at Bayside High in this beloved NBC Saturday morning sitcom that defined 90s teen culture.
questions.answer: What is Saved by the Bell?

questions.question: This Nickelodeon series, set in Chicago, starred two best friends whose misadventures were fueled in part by one character's insatiable love for orange soda — and launched the career of one of SNL's longest-tenured cast members.

This Canadian teen drama premiered in 1987, tackled issues like teen pregnancy, gun violence, and drug abuse before it was considered appropriate — and was later rebooted with a young Drake in its cast.
This flat rubber novelty item, invented in Canada in the 1930s, is placed on a chair so the next unsuspecting visitor produces a thoroughly embarrassing noise upon sitting.
A famous campfire scene in this 1974 Mel Brooks comedy Western — where cowboys freely pass gas after eating beans — is widely considered Hollywood's first major flatulence scene.
Japanese author Taro Gomi's 1990 picture book, translated into dozens of languages, teaches young readers that every living creature — from elephant to fly — does this universal thing.
In his 1994 film, Jim Carrey plays a detective who dramatically exits a robotic rhino's rear end — one of cinema's most memorably scatological exits that kids have been quoting for 30 years.
questions.answer: What is Ace Ventura: Pet Detective?

questions.question: Often cited as the film that mainstreamed lowbrow comedy in America, this 1978 John Landis film starred John Belushi as Bluto Blutarsky and set the template for decades of gross-out comedies.
The seven-letter clinical word doctors prefer to 'fart' — derived from the Latin 'flatus,' meaning a blowing — is the term used in polite society and medical literature for intestinal gas.

This Victorian-era British plumber's delightfully unfortunate surname has made schoolchildren giggle for over a century — though despite popular legend, he did not invent the toilet, merely helped popularize it.
While most intestinal gas is odorless, this sulfur-containing molecule — which also makes rotten eggs smell — is the chief culprit behind the characteristic aroma of a fart.
Found beneath every toilet and sink, this curved plumbing pipe holds a small pool of water that blocks sewer gases from rising into your home — and is named after the letter its profile resembles.
Derived from the Greek 'skatos' meaning excrement, this nine-letter word is the technical term for the scientific study of feces — used in archaeology, forensic science, and medicine.
